method.order: Untimed baseline result seed, two OFF warmups each, ten OFF pairs alternating order. One final ON diagnostic per version excluded from OFF statistics.
method.reference: Exact d2cd069 road_tools with frozen original road_surface and surface_materials; all other helpers shared and unchanged.
method.scope: CPU fixtures, builtin materials; includes uneven heightfield and existing authored roads. Real PBR/UI/HTTP tested separately. Not UI latency, FPS, memory, significance or tail latency. Other sessions/system load unmanaged.
method.timing: Wall around prepare only; setup, serialization, hashes, checks and report I/O excluded. Full input/output bytes verified on every call.
